meta.title: Live captions
meta.description: Captures system audio and the microphone, transcribes speech with a local SenseVoice model, translates each line into the language you choose and floats the subtitles over the window. The same panel can write a structured meeting-minutes file. Open it from the "Live captions" pill at the bottom right; the first run downloads about 240 MB of recognition models. Audio never leaves the machine; only subtitle text is sent to your configured model provider for translation and minutes.
